messages:
maria: Atlas reports 10 H200s arrived DOA at FRA depot, asking if we want partial replace or air-expedite. 4 serials flagged as mismatched.
sam: ugh. can you drop the AWB and the depot photo evidence here?
vendor-atlas: AWB attached below. photos uploaded to the dropbox link.
vendor-atlas: ```\nAWB: 987-65432100\nCarrier: EuroFly\nETA: 2025-08-03 07:30 CEST\nShipment: 100 H200s\nIssue: 10 DOA, 4 serial mismatch (tags swapped)\nDepot: FRA-DC7\n``` 
alex: need to know replacement lead time and cost delta for air vs sea. also confirm whether depot can stage replacements same-day if we send loaners.
maria: Atlas says next batch ship: sea 6-8 weeks, air 5 days (expedite). quoted air surcharge = $1,200/unit, plus brokerage. sea is no surcharge.
jin: from infra side, running low on EU provision pool. If we lose 10 H200s we drop below 95% for Dedicated EU peak queue. Can we short-borrow from NA? cross-region move will add 40-60ms to tail latency for those customers.
sam: short-borrowing is painful for hot customers. prefer air-expedite for critical SKUs. which units are DOA vs mismatch? any firmware/PN differences?
vendor-atlas: 6 DOA (power board failure), 4 serial mismatches found during intake QC. mismatches are H200 v2 vs H200 v2 (same PN) but wrong serial pairing — likely packing error, not firmware.
procurement-bot: PO #RC-4421 attached, warranty cover applies for DOA within 30 days. Atlas requests RMA authorization number for air replacements.
maria: can we do a split RMA: 6 air-replace for DOA, 4 ground-replace after serial recon? saves ~$4.8k vs air all.
alex: yes for operations. but need depot to confirm they can hold the 4 suspect units for serial audit and reassign once corrected.
vendor-atlas: FRA-DC7 confirms hold capability for 7 days. after that they'll return to vendor network if no disposition.
jin: ops note — if we accept 6 air units, update routing policy so requests for EU peak go to non-affected hosts first; otherwise we risk noisy neighbor retries.
sam: agree. also request Atlas to mark AWB with RMA# once they ship. need tracker entry in the inventory DB: rma:RC-4421-ATLAS-1
maria: sending RMA auth to Atlas now. prepping /expedite request. @procurement-bot please confirm accounting code for surcharge.
procurement-bot: accounting: CAPEX-ENG-HW, expedite fee approved up to $15k for urgent replacements. file expense under RC-4421.
vendor-atlas: RMA auth issued: RMA-AT-8842. Air booking scheduled 2025-08-04 23:00 UTC. AWB will be updated with RMA tag.
sam: please paste AWB once updated. also request photos of packaging and final depot sign-off. we'll need them for insurance claim if discrepancy grows.
alex: side note — can we request Atlas to pre-visualize serial reassignment manifest so we can ingest corrected serials sooner? avoids manual depot work.
vendor-atlas: will provide CSV manifest 1 hour before pickup.
maria: OK condensed plan: 1) Approve air-replace for 6 DOA (RMA-AT-8842), Atlas to attach RMA-AWB and CSV manifest. 2) Hold 4 mismatched units at FRA-DC7 for serial audit, then ground-replace if needed. 3) Sam/Jin update routing and inventory once AWB/manifest inbound. 4) Procurement to code expedite fee to RC-4421.
sam: noted. I'll update the routing policy now and add a temporary capacity buffer of +10% for EU Dedicated pool.
jin: doing a quick health check on affected hostgroup, will post results shortly.
vendor-atlas: AWB updated: 987-65432100 (RMA-AT-8842). pickup ETA 2025-08-04. CSV manifest link: https://atlas.example/csvs/RMA-AT-8842-manifest.csv
maria: :thumbsup: thanks. Jin ping when health check done and we'll close this thread.
jin: health check: EU-dedicated-pool 0.96 avail, tail latency within SLO. applied routing fallback — no customer impact observed in last 30m. closing loop.
alex: filed depot photos + manifest in ops-triage. leaving a follow-up ticket to verify serial fix next week.
maria: closing — will reopen if any variance.
